$comment: The example set (issue 18). The app's routes (src/routes.tsx), the docs Examples page (apps/docs/src/components/LocalExample) and the E2E fixtures of issue 19 all read this list; test/catalog.test.mjs keeps them in step. `files` are relative to src/examples; `docs` marks examples the docs embed; `fixtures` names the behaviours issue 19 tests on that route.

examples.title: Basic scene
examples.summary: Register Pixi classes with extend, then render a container, a graphic and a sprite whose texture is a local asset.

examples.title: Updates and events
examples.summary: Pixi pointer events and DOM buttons update React state, and the new props reach the scene.

examples.title: Custom components
examples.summary: Register your own Pixi class with extend and give it JSX types through PixiElements.

examples.title: Hooks and the ticker
examples.summary: Read the application with useApplication, animate with useTick, and pause the callback with isEnabled.

examples.title: Initialization and unmount
examples.summary: Run code once the application is ready with onInit, then unmount and remount the Application.

examples.title: Modular renderer (createRenderer)
examples.summary: Compose a renderer from the React 19.3 and Pixi 8 adapters, use component(Ctor), and handle a failed initialization with onInitError.
